why_relevant: A second CBK host indexed by search engines that exposes the English URL scheme for Executive Board decisions and financial statements. Useful for reverse-engineering canonical paths on the main site and as an alternate retrieval route if the primary host blocks a collector.

source_name: Quipu GmbH processing-centre staff profiles (ProCredit group IT/processing arm) on LinkedIn
why_relevant: Quipu is the ProCredit group's IT/card-processing arm and staffs Kosovo-linked processing roles; individual profiles of processing-centre leadership reveal card/switch platform responsibilities and moves that never appear in bank press releases.

Serbian-language portal for the Gračanica area covering political/social/economic issues; relevant for enclave-level bank branch presence, salary payment channels and hiring at Serbia-funded institutions. Ownership documented in Media Ownership Monitor (Omonia; founded 2016).

source_name: Albanian ICT Awards (ALBICT / ictawards.org) — pan-Albanian technology awards incl. Kosovo entrants
why_relevant: The main regional technology award with Albania, Kosovo and North Macedonia entrants; nominee and winner listings name individuals and their employers, and finance/fintech categories capture digital-banking teams. Award citations are dated title statements usable as weak leadership signals for the tech side of banks.

source_name: ARBK Atlas (arbk.atlas-studio.eu) — third-party Kosovo business registry front-end
why_relevant: Another independent front-end advertising 240,000+ Kosovo companies; alternative access route and possible field coverage differences (e.g. officer names) versus arbk.org. Redundancy matters because the official portal is the single point of failure for this cell.

source_name: Balkan Green Energy News — regional appointments coverage (EBRD/IFI people moves)
why_relevant: Despite the energy focus, it reliably reports IFI regional-director appointments (e.g. EBRD Western Balkans head) that determine financing counterparties and reorganisations touching Kosovo banks.

source_name: connectingregion.com (The Region) — Western Balkans institutional analysis
why_relevant: English-language regional outlet producing explainer/analysis pieces on why particular IFI and institutional appointments matter for Kosovo — an example of the translator/commentary layer this cell targets.

source_name: EMIS company profiles — key executives for Kosovo banks
why_relevant: Commercial database maintaining 'contacts & key executives' records per Kosovo bank entity; useful as a cross-check on executive rosters when a bank's own page is stale, and it carries the legal entity names (Sh.a.) used in official filings.

Small Serb-community outlet that surfaced covering Belgrade's 'kadrovska slagalica' (personnel puzzle) for Kosovo — i.e. appointment decisions for parallel-structure institutions. Marginal for commercial banks but relevant to the payments/parallel-financial-institution edge of the sector.

Surfaced a headcount-specific item ('38 zaposlenih', NLB Komercijalna banka ceasing operations in Kosovo) — exactly the staff-count granularity A5 needs. Editorially a state-media outlet, so the number needs corroboration.
The Çolakoğlu/BNP Paribas holding vehicle above TEB; ownership-level changes here propagate to the Kosovo unit's governance.

source_name: The Banker (thebanker.com) — editorial, CEO profiles and appointments
why_relevant: Global banking trade title; occasional CEE/Western Balkans CEO profiles and 'movers' items that give analytic framing to appointments at groups operating in Kosovo.

source_name: Zyrtare.net / Arbresh.info — labour-safety and inspectorate-capacity reporting
why_relevant: Carry inspectorate statistics stories (e.g. workplace-death totals since 2018 and the count of only ~53 inspectors nationwide). Useful as a fast secondary channel that surfaces inspectorate figures before or instead of the inspectorate's own publication, and as a capacity indicator for how much enforcement signal to expect.

source_name: Çalık Holding — corporate news / financial services segment
why_relevant: Ultimate owner of the BKT franchise; holding-level communications occasionally announce banking-segment executive changes before BKT's own sites are updated.
